verdict.rationale: Superset orchestrates coding agents and offers a built-in diff viewer and a Pull requests view, but there it is the human who selects diff lines and sends feedback to an agent. Nothing in the pack shows agents automatically reviewing every PR or posting AI-generated inline comments. Cron-style automations and the CLI-from-CI could in theory be scripted toward this, but no evidence documents a PR-triggered review flow or inline comment output.
